source_conflicts_or_version_issues: The manuscript is an unedited Article in Press and may change before final publication.

Results state that four Center 2 samples were excluded because informed consent was not obtained, while Methods state that all ethics committees waived informed consent for residual specimens; the extraction preserves both source statements without reconciliation.
The manuscript references supplementary tables, figures, and R scripts, but no supplementary file was included in the supplied PDF.
extraction_limitations: Atoms cover the primary design, workflow, endpoints, clinically load-bearing quantitative results, limitations, disclosures, and availability statements; they do not exhaustively atomize every statistic in Tables 2-4.
Supplementary materials were unavailable, so supplement-only findings and code could not be independently extracted or validated.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review because no independent human source verification was performed after model-assisted extraction.
QuantitativeResult supports one primary interval per atom; comparator confidence intervals are retained in canonical statements only when central and are not always separately encoded.
